_note: Sixteen practices to fill thin area and category pages (19 September 2026): Scarborough 6 to 9 and Joondalup 4 to 7 (north), Leederville 4 to 7 and a third yoga studio in Perth CBD (central), two meditation offerings in Fremantle, Mandurah 3 to 5 and Rockingham 4 to 6 (peel). Every field is taken from the practice's own website on 19 September 2026; nothing is inferred, and where a site publishes no price priceFrom is null. No ratings, reviews or photographs are copied; each row names a theme scene. Left out: chain branches that share a website or phone with a listed branch (the importer would treat them as duplicates) -- The Studio Perth Joondalup, endota spa Mandurah, Best Body Leederville. No ice bath studio operates in Joondalup itself; the nearest are listed already (Beldon, Currambine).

listings.name: The Yoga Room and Pilates
listings.address: Unit 2, 60 Scarborough Beach Road, Scarborough WA 6019
listings.blurb: A yoga and Pilates studio on Scarborough Beach Road, upstairs from Jetts Gym with entry from the car park. It runs more than 60 classes a week across yoga, mat and reformer Pilates, breathwork, meditation and sound bath sessions, plus family-friendly yoga classes. A casual yoga class is $29 and a casual reformer class is $37, with class packs, weekly memberships and intro passes also available. Bookings are made through Mindbody.
listings._source: theyogaroomandpilates.com.au — address, email, class types, class count (home page); casual/pack/membership/intro prices (/pricing). Checked 2026-09-19. No phone published on the site.

listings.name: Proactive Pilates
listings.blurb: A reformer Pilates studio in the Horizon Building on Brighton Road, a short walk from Scarborough Beach, run since 2010 by accredited exercise physiologist and Pilates instructor Teresa Holmes. Group reformer classes on Allegro 2 reformers are capped at 12 people, alongside private and semi-private sessions, clinical Pilates, exercise physiology and physiotherapy. A casual class is $39 and a one-to-one session $95. Open Monday to Friday from 6am, with shorter weekend morning hours.
listings._source: proactivepilates.com.au — address, phone, email, services, hours (home page); owner, 2010 start, 12-person cap, Allegro 2 reformers (/about/); casual $39, 1:1 $95, packs and memberships (/pricing-5/). Checked 2026-09-19. Postcode 6019 not printed on site (standard Scarborough postcode).

listings.name: Scarborough Traditional Acupuncture
listings.blurb: An acupuncture and Chinese medicine clinic on Scarborough Beach Road, established in 1991 by Dr Trudy Matthews and now staffed by six registered Chinese medicine practitioners. The clinic offers acupuncture, Chinese herbal consultations, cupping, facial acupuncture and paediatric consultations. An initial acupuncture consultation is $130 and a follow-up $100, with cupping from $65. Open Monday to Friday 9am to 7pm and Saturday 9am to 2pm.

Checked 2026-09-19. Contact page prints postcode 6018; used 6019 (Scarborough) — see flag.

listings.name: The Pilates Klinik
listings.blurb: A family-owned reformer Pilates studio on Delage Street in Joondalup, with more than 20 years in the Pilates industry and over 60 in-studio classes a week. Alongside group reformer classes it offers private Pilates, pregnancy Pilates, a Pilates programme for people over 50, stretch therapy and remedial massage. A single group reformer session is $39, a 10-pack $330, and a drop-in private session $110.
listings._source: thepilatesklinik.com.au — address, phone, email, services, family-owned, class count (home page); single $39, 10-pack $330, private $110 (/pricing). Checked 2026-09-19.

listings.name: The Pilates Warehouse
listings.blurb: A reformer, mat and barre Pilates studio on Mercer Lane in Joondalup, set up with a focus on keeping Pilates affordable. Classes are pitched at all fitness levels, with instructors offering modifications, and are booked through the Momence app. A casual mat class is $20 and a casual reformer class $26, with 10-class packs and no-lock-in weekly memberships from $18 a week. Grip socks are required for all classes.
listings._source: thepilateswarehouse.com.au — address, phone, email, class types, casual/pack/membership prices, grip-sock rule, Momence booking (home page, Canva site read from page source). Checked 2026-09-19. No hours published.

listings.name: Aurora Therapeutic Massage
listings.blurb: A massage clinic on Grand Boulevard in Joondalup, opened in 2015 by owner and remedial massage therapist Puan Yangbun and now run with a team of four therapists. Treatments include remedial, sports, deep tissue, relaxation, pregnancy and Thai yoga massage, plus reflexology, lymphatic drainage, cupping and dry needling. Open seven days, Monday to Saturday until 7:30pm and Sunday 8am to 6pm.

listings.name: AirSpace
listings.blurb: AirSpace is an aerial bodyweight studio on Newcastle Street in Leederville, just off Loftus Street, and the home of AirYoga, its original aerial hammock class. The group timetable also covers gymnastic rings strength, handstands, flexibility training and a patterns and groundwork class. A single drop-in class is $39, with class packs and memberships available. Personal training and on-site physiotherapy are offered, and students need to be 15 or over.

listings.name: Revolution Pilates & GYROTONIC Studio
listings.blurb: Revolution Pilates & GYROTONIC Studio is an equipment-based studio on Carr Place in Leederville, directed by Neil Nabbefeld. New clients start with at least two 60-minute private sessions before moving to semi-private sessions of no more than four people per instructor, each on an individual program. The studio also runs GYROTONIC and GYROKINESIS sessions, group floor classes and fitBABES, a pre- and postnatal Pilates program. Studio sessions run weekday mornings and evenings and Saturday mornings.

listings.name: Redefined Studio
listings.blurb: Redefined Studio is a reformer Pilates studio on Oxford Street in Leederville that runs both screen-led and instructor-led classes. The timetable includes Orientation and First Timers sessions for newcomers, plus Fundamentals, Level Up, Core, Stretch and Coached classes. Membership runs weekly: $9.95 for one class a week, $14.95 for two, or $19.95 for unlimited classes, with a one-week free trial. Bookings are made through the studio's app.

listings.name: Energy Cntr Yoga
listings.blurb: Energy Cntr Yoga is a yoga and mat Pilates studio on Stirling Street in Perth, owned by teacher Simone Saywell. The room holds 35 students, and classes include Vinyasa, Deep, Mellow and Slow Flow, Hatha, Power Flow, Yin and Meditation, Deep Stretch and several mat Pilates formats. A casual class is $28, with 5, 10 and 20-class packs and weekly or monthly unlimited memberships. The studio opens only for scheduled classes.

listings.name: meditationHQ Sunrise Saturdays, Bathers Beach
listings.address: Bathers Beach, Mews Road, Fremantle WA 6160
listings.blurb: A free weekly community meditation held outdoors at Bathers Beach in Fremantle, meeting at the hut in front of the art centre on Mews Road. Sessions start at 6.30am each Saturday and follow three steps: a welcome circle, a 20-minute meditation combining mindfulness, breath and gratitude, then a closing circle. Trained volunteer facilitators lead each session. It is free, open to beginners and experienced meditators, has no religious affiliation and needs no registration.
listings._source: meditationhq.com.au (sunrise-saturdays + about-us pages): Fremantle meeting point and address, 6.30am Saturday time, free/no registration, 3-step format and 20-min length, volunteer facilitators, email. Checked 2026-09-19.

listings.name: Oversoul Studio
listings.blurb: A small studio within the Sanctuary Wellness Collective on Wood Street, Fremantle, founded by Amy and run as a collective of women practitioners. The published programme includes a fortnightly Monday meditation and sound bath from 6.30pm to 7.30pm, a weekly Thursday evening stretch class, and monthly sound bath and yoga events. Practitioners also offer one-on-one sessions in reiki, breathwork, yoga therapy, kinesiology and remedial massage, by appointment.
listings._source: oversoulstudio.com.au (home, contact, book-classes-&-events, practitioners pages): address, phone, email, collective description, class timetable, practitioner modalities. No prices published on own site. Checked 2026-09-19.

listings.name: 4 Life Sports & Remedial Massage
listings.blurb: A massage clinic on Rafferty Road in Mandurah, part of the 4 Life Physiotherapy group. Its therapists are registered with AAMT and offer remedial, sports, Swedish, deep tissue, pregnancy, seniors and trigger point massage, plus reflexology, in 30, 60 or 90-minute appointments. Published prices run from $60 for 30 minutes and $99 for an hour to $155 for a 90-minute hot stone massage. Late weekday and Saturday appointments are offered, with HICAPS health fund claiming.
listings._source: 4lifemassage.com.au (home, about, product pages): address, phone, services, session lengths, prices ($60/30min, $99/60min, $145/90min, $155/90min hot stone), AAMT registration, HICAPS, late weekday + Saturday hours. Checked 2026-09-19.

listings.name: MPG Pilates
listings.blurb: A classical Pilates studio and equipped Pilates gym on Anstruther Road in Mandurah, founded by Sharon Michau (formerly trading as My Pilates Gym). Group classes include 45-minute reformer, jumpboard reformer, matwork and Fit Barre sessions, plus 60-minute anti-gravity classes and DanceFit. Casual classes are $35 for matwork and Fit Barre and $45 for reformer and anti-gravity, with private hour-long sessions from $95. Classes are booked through the studio timetable or app.
listings._source: mpgpilates.com (home + classes pages): name, address, phone, email, founder, class list, class lengths, casual and private prices. Checked 2026-09-19.

listings.name: Royal Silk Remedial Thai Massage
listings.blurb: A Thai massage shop on Kent Street in Rockingham offering traditional Thai, remedial, deep tissue, sports Thai, relaxation, aromatherapy, pregnancy and hot stone massage, along with foot reflexology and facials. It opens seven days: 8am to 8pm Monday and Thursday to Sunday, and 10am to 7pm on Tuesday and Wednesday. An early-bird deal takes $10 off one-hour or longer massages booked between 8am and 2pm. Health fund rebates apply to remedial massage via HICAPS.

listings.name: STRONG Pilates Rockingham
listings.blurb: The Rockingham studio of the STRONG Pilates group, in a purpose-built space on Robinson Road with 18 custom reformer beds, Rowformers and Bikeformers. Its 45-minute classes combine reformer Pilates with strength and cardio work, with a different class each day. New clients can start with a 10-day unlimited introductory pass for $59. The studio has change rooms, showers, a mobility area and off-street parking.
